ai.title: Web: replace email signup with Manicode npm link
ai.summary: Home page email input and submit button removed from `web/src/app/page.tsx`, replaced by direct link to `manicode` npm package. Footer gains Airtable form link in `web/src/components/footer.tsx`. Navbar Features/Pricing/Docs anchors commented out in `web/src/components/navbar/navbar.tsx`.

eli5.text: Visitors landing on the home page no longer see a form to enter their email; the blue "Start Coding with AI" button now opens the Manicode package page on the npm website in a new browser tab. A new "Keep in touch!" link appears in the page footer, leading to an Airtable-hosted form that collects contact information. Three navigation links labeled Features, Pricing, and Docs in the top menu bar have been hidden, so the header menu now shows only the Manicode logo and login-related options.
